text: **Hint 1:** To find the derivative of the given objective function with respect to θ, recall the basic derivative rules. The derivative of a constant times a variable is the constant, and the derivative of a logarithm function is the reciprocal of the argument.\n\n**Hint 2:** Consider how the derivative of the logarithmic term affects the overall derivative. Remember that the derivative of $$\ln\left(\theta\right)$$ with respect to θ is $$\frac{1}{\theta}$$. Use this to simplify the expression for the derivative of the entire objective function.
